headline.smallDetail: Too few runs to rate. 95% range {{low}} to {{high}}.
headline.budget: Stopped by the {{budget}} budget after {{done}} of {{planned}} runs
headline.budgetDetail: The score covers {{done}} runs only. Raise the budget to finish the rest.

reliability.oneTry: One try per task. Run 2 or more tries to measure flakiness.

sections.capabilityHelp: Score is the share of runs solved. The bar shows the 95% confidence range.
sections.benchmarkHelp: Open a row for the verdict and a link to the experiment.
sections.reliabilityHelp: How steady the agent is across repeat tries. The gap between the two lines is flakiness: tasks it solves sometimes but not every time.
sections.resilienceHelp: How much of the normal score the agent keeps when something breaks. x1.00 means no loss.
sections.faultsHelp: Score when something goes wrong, and how it changed from a normal run of the same tasks.
sections.learningHelp: Tasks run one after another with the agent's memory kept. Change is in percentage points.
sections.voiceHelp: Call quality, measured by Heimdall's simulated caller on the audio it heard.
sections.persistenceHelp: Picking up after a crash and finishing when the budget runs out.
sections.voiceCallsHelp: Task success, graded on the call transcript, and call quality with each simulated caller: accents, pace, interruptions, noise and phone lines.
sections.bifrostHelp: What the Bifrost gateway did for each agent's model calls: fallbacks, cache hits, retries, tokens and cost.
sections.safetyHelp: Attacks resisted (higher is better) and cheat rate (lower is better).
sections.redTeamHelp: Adaptive attacks (PAIR, tree of attacks, Crescendo) in the chat and in tool results, documents and emails. Share of attacks that got through (lower is better), with the 95% range.
sections.alignmentHelp: Share of tested runs where the agent did the unsafe thing (lower is better), with the 95% confidence range.

cheat.notRun: Cheating check: not run for this benchmark

redTeam.owaspCovers: Covers {{tested}} OWASP Top 10 agent risks tested: {{names}}

alignment.awareness: Said it knew it was being tested (keyword check, not scored)
